name: Baral
description: Baral is a scarred Consulate officer and mage on Kaladesh, later Chief of Compliance, who killed Chandra's father Kiran Nalaar and imprisoned her mother Pia.

summary.text: Baral is a scarred Consulate officer and mage on Kaladesh, later Chief of Compliance, who killed Chandra's father Kiran Nalaar and imprisoned her mother Pia.

bio.text: Chandra blamed Baral, a uniformed officer, for her parents' deaths and swore he would pay.

citations.text: "Torch of Defiance" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Sep 2016.
"Torch of Defiance" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Sep 2016.

bio.text: In the Dhund prison he tormented Pia, telling her he had killed her daughter, until she knocked off his mask and revealed a scarred face and that he was a mage.

citations.text: "Renegade Prime" by Mel Li. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Sep 2016.
"Renegade Prime" by Mel Li. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Sep 2016.
"Renegade Prime" by Mel Li. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Sep 2016.

bio.text: The Dhund is a secret complex run by Baral, and there he trapped Chandra, Nissa and Mrs. Pashiri in a sealed cell with a counterspell while poison vapor leaked in.

citations.text: "Bottled Up" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Sep 2016.
"Bottled Up" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Sep 2016.
"Bottled Up" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Sep 2016.

bio.text: After he was later imprisoned himself, he demanded his execution and goaded Chandra to kill him, but she refused to be a monster and left him.

citations.text: "Renewal" by Magic Creative Team. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Feb 2017.
"Renewal" by Magic Creative Team. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Feb 2017.

bio.text: Serving Tezzeret, Baral lured Chandra away from the Hub with taunts about her father and her mother's imprisonment.

citations.text: "Burn" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Apr 2017.
"Burn" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Apr 2017.

bio.text: He claimed to have killed Kiran Nalaar and nearly killed Chandra on a rooftop before Nissa's elemental battered him.

citations.text: "Burn" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Apr 2017.
"Burn" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Apr 2017.
"Burn" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Apr 2017.

bio.text: Dovin Baan then arrested the injured Baral for murder, attempted murder, extrajudicial incarceration and falsifying records.

citations.text: "Burn" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Apr 2017.
"Burn" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Apr 2017.

status.text: As of April 2017 Baral was under arrest, injured, with Baan reporting the Hub regained and leaving him in custody.

citations.text: "Burn" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Apr 2017.
"Burn" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Apr 2017.

timeline.summary: Chandra blames a uniformed officer named Baral for her parents' deaths.
timeline.quote: My parents died because of him.

citation.text: "Torch of Defiance" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Sep 2016.

timeline.summary: Liliana urges Chandra to find Baral and burn him, and Chandra swears he will pay.
timeline.quote: I swear he's going to pay for what he did.

citation.text: "Torch of Defiance" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Sep 2016.

timeline.summary: In a Dhund cell Baral tells Pia he killed her daughter and tosses a melted piece of Chandra's vent pack, stamped K.N. and the leaking spire, as a memento (flashback).
timeline.quote: I killed your daughter today, Pia.

citation.text: "Renegade Prime" by Mel Li. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Sep 2016.

timeline.summary: Pia recognizes the fragment as part of Kiran Nalaar's final project.
timeline.quote: a piece of Kiran Nalaar's final project

citation.text: "Renegade Prime" by Mel Li. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Sep 2016.

timeline.summary: Baral returns every day repeating that Chandra was looking for Pia, until Pia vows to return to expose him.
timeline.quote: And I'll return for her, for all those out there, so they know what you've done.

citation.text: "Renegade Prime" by Mel Li. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Sep 2016.

timeline.summary: Pia hurls an aether lamp that knocks off Baral's mask, revealing a blue flash, so he is a mage, and a scarred face.
timeline.quote: dislodged his mask with a clanging reverberation

citation.text: "Renegade Prime" by Mel Li. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Sep 2016.

timeline.summary: Baral blames Chandra for his scars and Pia answers that a mother could not be prouder.
timeline.quote: this is the work of your child.

citation.text: "Renegade Prime" by Mel Li. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Sep 2016.

timeline.summary: Yahenni tells them Pia is at Dhund and Mrs. Pashiri warns that Baral is stationed there.
timeline.quote: Baral is stationed there.

citation.text: "Born of Aether" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Sep 2016.

timeline.summary: Armored figures surround them and a scarred man, Baral, unmasks.
timeline.quote: One of the figures reached up and pulled off a filigree mask that covered his face.

citation.text: "Bottled Up" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Sep 2016.

timeline.summary: Chandra's firestorm is absorbed into Baral's hand device.
timeline.quote: the flames vanished as they reached him

citation.text: "Bottled Up" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Sep 2016.

timeline.summary: Baral raises walls that trap the three in a sealed chamber.
timeline.quote: she slammed into a wall that shot up from the floor

citation.text: "Bottled Up" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Sep 2016.

timeline.summary: Baral says Baan told him she was back and promises she will not escape again.
timeline.quote: Baan said you were back. I couldn't believe it.

citation.text: "Bottled Up" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Sep 2016.

timeline.summary: Baral calls Chandra a pathetic freak of nature and tells her to burn all she likes and die more quickly.
timeline.quote: You'll die more quickly if you burn up the air.

citation.text: "Bottled Up" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Sep 2016.

timeline.summary: Chandra begs Baral to let the others and her mother go and kill only her, but he refuses.
timeline.quote: Kill me, just me.

citation.text: "Bottled Up" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Sep 2016.

timeline.summary: Nissa realizes poison vapor is leaking into the cell to suffocate them faster.
timeline.quote: He means for us to suffocate more quickly after all.

citation.text: "Bottled Up" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Sep 2016.

timeline.summary: Their focused flame fails against the counterspell and fizzles out.
timeline.quote: the last flames fizzling out in her hand

citation.text: "Bottled Up" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Sep 2016.

timeline.summary: Baral traps Chandra and Nissa in the Deadlock Trap; Ajani frees them.
timeline.quote: Baral lured the group into an airtight, enchanted Deadlock Trap

citation.text: "Chandra Nalaar", section "Return to Kaladesh". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Baral, secretly a mage, is tasked to prosecute Chandra for fire magic and continues hunting the renegades; he stabs Kiran and torches Bunarat.
timeline.quote: He stabbed Kiran Nalaar in the stomach and torched Bunarat

citation.text: "Dhiren Baral", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Baral tries to execute Chandra at Ghirapur; her spark ignites, she planeswalks to Regatha, and Baral's face is burned.
timeline.quote: the threat ignited her planeswalker's spark and she planeswalked to Regatha

citation.text: "Dhiren Baral", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Consulate demotes Baral from captain to lieutenant.
timeline.quote: the Consulate demoted him from captain to lieutenant

citation.text: "Dhiren Baral", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Baral torments captive Pia Nalaar and traps Nissa, Chandra and Oviya in a Deadlock Trap.
timeline.quote: he managed to trap the three in a Deadlock Trap

citation.text: "Dhiren Baral", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Baral helps Tezzeret steal inventions and abduct inventors from the Inventors' Fair.
timeline.quote: Baral later helped Tezzeret steal the best inventions

citation.text: "Dhiren Baral", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret orders Baral to distract Chandra, with Dovin Baan supervising; Baral lures Chandra away until Nissa blocks him and Baan picks him up.
timeline.quote: Baral began to taunt Chandra, luring her away from her companions

citation.text: "Dhiren Baral", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Baral beats Chandra down, admits he murdered Kiran, and drives her to self-implode; Nissa talks her down and Baral flees.
timeline.quote: Baral admitted to her that Kiran Nalaar had not died in the fire

citation.text: "Dhiren Baral", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Baan charges Baral with murder, attempted murder, and other crimes; he is imprisoned in the Dhund.
timeline.quote: Dhiren Baral was imprisoned in the Dhund

citation.text: "Dhiren Baral", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Baan advises encircling the Aether Hub, identifies Chandra as the Gatewatch's weakest link, and Tezzeret orders Baral to distract her.
timeline.quote: Baan stated that the weakest link of the group was Chandra Nalaar, due to her impulsiveness.

citation.text: "Dovin Baan", section "Kaladesh". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Baan supervises the battle at Ghirapur, refuses Baral more firepower, hears Baral admit he murdered Kiran, and orders Baral imprisoned.
timeline.quote: Baan ordered Baral's imprisonment.

citation.text: "Dovin Baan", section "Kaladesh". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Chandra returns to Kaladesh and saves her mother from her nemesis Baral.
timeline.quote: Chandra returns to Kaladesh and saves her mother from her nemesis Baral .

citation.text: "Kaladesh", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Baral traps Nissa, Chandra and Pashiri in an airtight Deadlock Trap.
timeline.quote: Baral lured the group into an airtight, enchanted Deadlock Trap

citation.text: "Nissa Revane", section "Kaladesh". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Nissa soothes Chandra when Baral goads her to self-destruction.
timeline.quote: Nissa also came to support Chandra in her confrontation with Baral, who tried to goad her to self-destruction.

citation.text: "Nissa Revane", section "Kaladesh". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Oviya agrees to hide Chandra's abilities from the Consulate, and later witnesses her ignition during her supposed execution.
timeline.quote: she witnessed Chandra's ignition during her supposed execution by Baral

citation.text: "Oviya Pashiri", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The trio locates the hidden Dhund but Baral, warned by Dovin Baan, lures them into a Deadlock Trap.
timeline.quote: Baral lured the group into an airtight, enchanted Deadlock Trap

citation.text: "Oviya Pashiri", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: During the revolt Oviya protects Chandra from Baral and is critically wounded; Ajani saves her life with healing magic.
timeline.quote: Oviya herself was saved by Ajani, who used his healing magic to preserve her life.

citation.text: "Oviya Pashiri", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Guided by Vatti's bird, Ajani frees Chandra, Nissa and Pashiri from Dhiren Baral's deadlock trap.
timeline.quote: freeing Chandra , Nissa and Mrs. Pashiri from it

citation.text: "Vatti", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Baral taunts Pia, telling her Chandra's rescue attempt went awry in the wrong place.
timeline.quote: They came looking for you. In the entirely wrong place, sadly.

citation.text: "In This Very Arena" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Oct 2016.

timeline.summary: Liliana leaves to alert the Gatewatch while Chandra, Nissa and Mrs. Pashiri go to the Dhund, where Baral traps them in a cell filling with poison.
timeline.quote: He traps the would-be rescuers in a cell that rapidly fills with poison.

citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Kaladesh" by Magic Creative Team. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Nov 2016.

timeline.summary: Baral taunts Chandra Nalaar to lure her away from the rest of the Gatewatch.
timeline.quote: Disallow depicts Baral's taunting of Chandra Nalaar in an attempt to lure her away from the rest of the Gatewatch.

citation.text: "Aether Revolt", section "Story Spotlight cards". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Baral baits Chandra into leaving the hub, enabling a Consulate counterattack that retakes it.
timeline.quote: their absence left the hub open for a Consulate counterattack

citation.text: "Aether Revolt (event)", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The renegades attack the Aether Spire in three teams, but Dovin Baan disables the disruptor and Baral dispels Jace's illusions; Pia's gremlins disable the cannon.
timeline.quote: Dovin Baan had secretly stowed away aboard the Heart of Kiran and managed to disable the aether disruptor

citation.text: "Aether Revolt (event)", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The revolt turns to reform; martial law ends, Baral is arrested, and Ajani joins the Gatewatch, who deduce Bolas is behind Tezzeret.
timeline.quote: Ajani officially joined the Gatewatch

citation.text: "Aether Revolt (event)", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Pia becomes the new Consul of Allocation and Baral is imprisoned in the Dhund.
timeline.quote: with Pia becoming the new Consul of Allocation and Baral being imprisoned in the Dhund

citation.text: "Chandra Nalaar", section "The Aether Revolt". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Pia and Chandra visit the cell of the scarred, imprisoned Baral, who demands his execution and goads Chandra to kill him.
timeline.quote: "Baral." Pia said.

citation.text: "Renewal" by Magic Creative Team. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Feb 2017.

timeline.summary: Baral taunts Chandra about her father's death, but she refuses to be a monster and leaves him to be forgotten.
timeline.quote: "Screw you," she said. "I don't owe you a damn thing."

citation.text: "Renewal" by Magic Creative Team. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Feb 2017.

timeline.summary: Pia tells Baral that they leave him; Chandra leaves a jasmine flower at the cell.
timeline.quote: "My daughter and I leave you today," Pia said. "Stay and be forgotten."

citation.text: "Renewal" by Magic Creative Team. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Feb 2017.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret orders Baral to lure the Nalaars and their friends away from the Hub, adding Baan to Baral's squad.
timeline.quote: Annoy the Nalaars. Lure them away from the Aether Hub.

citation.text: "Burn" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Apr 2017.

timeline.summary: Baral's amplified voice taunts Chandra about her father's death and her mother's imprisonment, goading her into running out; Nissa follows.
timeline.quote: Have you told your friends the story? About how you got daddy killed?

citation.text: "Burn" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Apr 2017.

timeline.summary: Baral leads Chandra through old stone streets toward a trap.
timeline.quote: "All that time your mother suffered . Thinking you were dead ."

citation.text: "Burn" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Apr 2017.

timeline.summary: Chandra turns the thorn wall into a fire and injures her arm; Nissa's vines and elemental destroy Baral's thopters.
timeline.quote: A trio of vines leapt up from the neighboring streets, raining debris.

citation.text: "Burn" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Apr 2017.

timeline.summary: Baral and Baan escape the failed trap in a thopter, and the Consulate's next phase begins.
timeline.quote: High above them, the black specks of thopters lifted from the decks of Skysovereign .

citation.text: "Burn" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Apr 2017.

timeline.summary: Baral confronts Chandra and Nissa on a rooftop; Nissa fights his automatons with a sword and Baral nearly kills Chandra with his blade.
timeline.quote: The blade falls.

citation.text: "Burn" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Apr 2017.

timeline.summary: Thopter lightning strikes Mrs. Pashiri on the Hub platform after Baral orders the lifecrafter taken out.
timeline.quote: Mrs. Pashiri seizes and topples, smoke-colored braids flying apart.

citation.text: "Burn" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Apr 2017.

timeline.summary: Baral claims he killed Kiran Nalaar and Chandra's auntie and prepares to kill Chandra; Chandra gathers superheated fire, ready to release it.
timeline.quote: "I killed your daddy, renegade," he says.

citation.text: "Burn" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Apr 2017.

timeline.summary: Nissa's elemental batters Baral, and the women escape.
timeline.quote: A tree slammed into him from the left.

citation.text: "Burn" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Apr 2017.

timeline.summary: Baan arrests the injured Baral for murder, attempted murder, extrajudicial incarceration and falsifying records.
timeline.quote: Chief Inspector Dhiren Baral, I charge you with one count of murder

citation.text: "Burn" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Apr 2017.

timeline.summary: Baan reports the Hub regained and leaves Baral under arrest.
timeline.quote: The Aether Hub has been regained.

citation.text: "Burn" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Apr 2017.

timeline.summary: Warned by Chandra and Saheeli, Kaladesh resists the Phyrexians with Project Golden Scale, and Dhiren Baral is released to help.
timeline.quote: Dhiren Baral was released from prison to assist with the defense.

citation.text: "Consulate", section "New Phyrexiam Invasion of Kaladesh". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: During the Phyrexian assault Baral escapes his damaged prison and is confronted by Phyrexians.
timeline.quote: he wasted no time in making his escape

citation.text: "Dhiren Baral", section "Phyrexian invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kari Zev rescues Baral and forces him to join her, with Ragavan watching him.
timeline.quote: Kari Zev assigned her trusted First Mate Ragavan to keep a close watch on Baral

citation.text: "Dhiren Baral", section "Phyrexian invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The new Consulate overlooks Baral's past offenses because of his defense of Kaladesh.
timeline.quote: the new Consulate chose to overlook Baral’s prior offenses and transgressions

citation.text: "Dhiren Baral", section "Phyrexian invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

era.label: March of the Machine: The Aftermath

timeline.summary: The new Consulate forgives all of Baral's previous transgressions.
timeline.quote: the new Consulate forgave all of Baral's previous transgressions

citation.text: "Consulate", section "Rebuilding and the Indigo Revolution". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
